verdict.rationale: Cal.com publishes an extensive, well-documented public REST API v2 (bookings, event types, slots, schedules, webhooks, conferencing apps, routing traces) with multiple auth methods (OAuth, API key), plus a dedicated agents.md guide explicitly targeting AI-driven usage and a hosted MCP server for natural-language control. Runtime probes confirm the MCP server is live and the docs index is reachable. Missing for 10: an official machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate paths 404), which would strengthen programmatic discoverability.
